question: What is the pettiest thing you have ever done to get back at someone?
story: I spent four hundred dollars on a garden gnome to win an argument about six inches of grass. My neighbor Gary measured our property line with a laser level. Twice. He decided my hedge was stealing six inches of his lawn and he wanted it torn out. I offered to split the cost of a real survey. He said no. He wanted an apology. So I paid for the survey myself. The line was actually four feet the other direction. His driveway was sitting on my property. I did not tell him. Instead I ordered a three foot concrete gnome, had it delivered, and set it exactly on the true line, in the middle of open grass, facing his kitchen window. He called the city on me. The inspector confirmed the gnome was on my land, then asked Gary about the driveway. Gary trims my hedge for me now. Neither of us has ever mentioned the gnome.
